tagline: 理光便携相机，1992 年发布
description: 理光于1992年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/4.5 - 60mm f/6.9, 1.6X Zoom, 5 elements in 5 groups。快门速度1 sec. (super-night mode), 1/4 -1/300 sec. (normal mode)。感光度ISO 64 - 3200 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofucus system, 30 focusing steps。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/4.5 - 60mm f/6.9, 1.6X Zoom, 5 elements in 5 groups
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofucus system, 30 focusing steps
specs.英文简介: The Myport Zoom mini is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1992 as the world's smallest[http://www.ricoh-imaging.co.jp/japan/products/ricoh-filmcamera/cameralist/ List of All Ricoh Cameras] on [http://www.ricoh-imaging.co.jp/japan/index.html Ricoh official website] (in Japanese) 35mm compact camera with a zoom lens.
